page.layout: Running head at top centre. One text column in the centre with marginal notes down the left margin: "3.Incli-natio," "4.In-stauratio," "5.Inte-ritus." and "(3)Scythicum." beside the heading. Catchword at the right foot. No page number, no signature.

main_text.p: 3.Incli-natio,Cùm post Cambysis obitum Magi, subornato quodam falsario, occupassent Imperium, redetectâ VII. nobilissimi Persarum proceres contra ipsum conjurarunt, & obtruncato 4.In-stauratio,tô illô deceptore Darium Hystaspis filium Regem salutarunt. Cui successit Xerxes, sub quo Imperium Persicum omnium magnificentissimum fuit. Post hunc regnarunt Artaxerxes, Ochus, Arses sive Arsames & ultimus Darius Codomannus; 5.Inte-ritus.quo triplici prælio superato Alexander Magnus imperio potitus fuit.
main_text.head: (3)Scythicum.IMPERIUM SCYTHICUM.

page.notes: The catchword at the lower right is cut off; read as "Exp" with [?]. The word "Expl." after the last paragraph is partly cut at the right edge and is therefore uncertain. Some letters in the margin notes and the italic words are slightly blurred. The circumflexes on "detectâ", "tô" and "illô" are uncertain. Right-hand edge shows show-through and the neighbouring page, which were omitted.
